summary: A drone attack struck US forces near Erbil airport in Iraq with a direct hit while air defenses remained inactive, marking a significant escalation in militia capabilities. Simultaneously, Iran-backed forces attacked two UAE tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting regional condemnation and a US naval blockade diverting 62 commercial vessels. Israeli operations intensified across southern Lebanon with artillery, airstrikes, and tank movements reported at multiple locations.
key_points: Drone attack on US forces near Erbil airport, Iraq: multiple drones, one direct hit, US air defenses inactive, fighters responded, airport closed. (Source: @VahidOnline/77862)
UAE condemns attack on two ADNOC tankers in Strait of Hormuz, no casualties; Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Egypt join condemnation, label IRGC piracy. (Source: @VahidOnline/77863)
Houthi spokesman claims ballistic missile attack on Saudi forces in Al-Makha, Yemen, targeting missiles, weapons, military boats. (Source: @kianmeli1/90870)
Israeli artillery, airstrikes, and tank movements reported across southern Lebanon: Hadatha, Ali al-Taher, Mansouri, Zoutar, Marjaba. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384668)
Israel and Lebanon agree on UK, Italy, Switzerland, Indonesia supervising Hezbollah disarmament per Reuters. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79276)
US Treasury announces unprecedented economic isolation on Iran; CENTCOM reports 62 commercial ships diverted by Iranian maritime blockade. (Source: @kianmeli1/90867, @rodast_omiddana/79282)
Iran's missile stockpile rebuilding faster than expected since 2026 US-Israeli war, shocking Israeli officials per PressTV. (Source: @presstv/202777)
Trump declares intent to designate Strait of Hormuz as US territory; USS George Washington carrier group deploying to replace Abraham Lincoln. (Source: @New_security8200/203313, @mamlekate/104146)

sections.executive_summary: A drone attack struck US forces near Erbil airport in Iraq with a direct hit while air defenses remained inactive, marking a significant escalation in militia capabilities. Simultaneously, Iran-backed forces attacked two UAE tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting regional condemnation and a US naval blockade diverting 62 commercial vessels. points: Iran's missile stockpile is rebuilding faster than expected since the 2026 US-Israeli war, shocking Israeli military officials and Mossad operatives according to PressTV reporting. (Source: @presstv/202777)
A smoke pillar appeared in southern Tehran with the nature of the fire unknown as of the report, indicating a possible incident in the capital region. (Source: @shin_persian/8962)

President Pezeshkian stated he will never stand against the Supreme Leader, emphasizing unity as paramount and claiming the enemy's main plan is toppling Iran from within. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384659)

US Treasury Secretary Bessent announced unprecedented economic isolation measures against Iran, while Defense Secretary Hegseth confirmed the naval blockade of Iranian ports can continue indefinitely. (Source: @mamlekate/104146)
Former President Trump claimed the US destroyed all of Iran's radars and sophisticated intelligence equipment, a claim repeated on social media. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384666)
Unverified reports allege Iran hit a ship in the Strait of Hormuz and downed a US drone on the same morning, though details remain unconfirmed. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94140)

Long gasoline queues have become a daily crisis across nine Iranian provinces including Bushehr, Hormozgan, Kurdistan, Kerman, Kermanshah, Lorestan, Khuzestan, South Khorasan, and East Azerbaijan. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79278)

The IDF launched an investigation into the illegal Kosra outpost events, examining why 48 hours passed before initial evacuation, why another 24 hours were needed after extremists returned, and why forces sent to the outpost did not evacuate it immediately. (Source: @yediotnews25/133925)

Defense Minister Israel Katz directed the IDF to prepare a plan transferring all civil enforcement powers in West Bank Israeli communities to Israel Police, stating the IDF's role is fighting Palestinian terrorism and border defense. (Source: @yediotnews25/133926)

Far-right Minister Ben Gvir posted a video boasting about the detention of a Palestinian bride and groom in the Naqab, claiming they obstructed traffic during their wedding convoy. (Source: @presstv/202778)

The Tzav 9 movement warned that spotters in Gaza prove Israel's hands are tied, demanding immediate freedom of action for the IDF to eliminate any Hamas threat and declaring every Hamas terrorist deserves immediate death. (Source: @almogboker78/17960)

A hot air balloon festival returned to the Gaza envelope after three years with 6,000 participants at Eshkol Park, marking the first approval since October 7 for balloon and paraglider flights near the Gaza border. (Source: @yediotnews25/133929)
Trump announced he will soon declare the Strait of Hormuz as US territory, a move with significant implications for Israeli strategic calculations. (Source: @New_security8200/203313)

Reuters reported Israel and Lebanon agreed on four countries — UK, Italy, Switzerland, Indonesia — to supervise Hezbollah disarmament, signaling a potential diplomatic framework. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79276)

The IDF investigation into the Kosra outpost will examine the 48-hour delay in initial evacuation, the additional 24 hours after extremists returned, the failure of deployed forces to evacuate immediately, and the decision to ask Palestinian families to leave their homes in the village. (Source: @yediotnews25/133925)

Defense Minister Katz ordered preparation of a plan to transfer all civil enforcement authority over Israeli communities in Judea and Samaria to Israel Police, removing the IDF from civilian law enforcement roles. (Source: @yediotnews25/133926)
Ben Gvir publicized the detention of a Palestinian bride and groom in the Naqab region, alleging they obstructed traffic during their wedding procession. (Source: @presstv/202778)

The Tzav 9 movement cited spotter warnings in Gaza as proof that Israel's hands are tied, demanding immediate IDF freedom of action to eliminate Hamas threats and declaring all Hamas members legitimate targets. (Source: @almogboker78/17960)

The hot air balloon festival at Eshkol Park near the Gaza border hosted 6,000 participants, the first such event since October 7, with official approval for flights near the frontier. (Source: @yediotnews25/133929)

Israeli forces conducted extensive operations across southern Lebanon: artillery shelling hit Hadatha, Ali al-Taher, Duha Kafrman, Dabsha, Mansouri, and Kfar Shuba outskirts; airstrikes targeted Mansouri fields and Wadi Adshit; drones dropped explosive gallons on Ali al-Taher heights and a sound bomb on Mansouri; flares illuminated Ali al-Taher and Houla; explosions occurred in Zoutar al-Sharqiya, Mansouri fields, and Marjaba. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384668)

Enemy vehicles moved at the northwestern outskirts of Hadatha and inside Zoutar al-Sharqiya with multiple tanks present, while machine gun fire was directed toward Mays al-Jabal. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384668)
Red Alert Lebanon issued maximum caution alerts for Beirut's Dahiyeh suburb and for the southern region due to warplane activity. (Source: @redlinkleb/36373, @redlinkleb/36411)

Hezbollah Secretary-General Sheikh Naim Qassem urged supporters to channel anger toward defending the resistance and Lebanon's sovereignty, warning opponents will face consequences. (Source: @presstv/202771)

The Houthi political office congratulated Hezbollah on the 20th anniversary of the July 2006 victory, stating Lebanese resistance achieved strategic deterrence balance with the Zionist enemy and imposed new rules of engagement. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384640)
Israel and Lebanon reportedly agreed on a four-nation mechanism — UK, Italy, Switzerland, Indonesia — to oversee Hezbollah disarmament, according to Reuters. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79276)

Iranian media reported a drone attack on US positions near Erbil airport in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq: multiple drones fired, one scored a direct hit, US air defenses did not activate, only US fighters responded, and Erbil airport was temporarily closed. (Source: @VahidOnline/77862)
UAV activity was reported over Baghdad, Iraq, indicating continued drone operations in Iraqi airspace. (Source: @shin_persian/8965)
Iraq's Oil Minister announced 2 million barrels per day exported since early August, the first such volume since Strait of Hormuz tensions began. (Source: @shin_persian/8960)

The UAE Foreign Ministry strongly condemned the attack on two ADNOC tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, confirming no casualties, labeling it a violation of UNSC Resolution 2817 and 'maritime piracy' by the IRGC, demanding Iran cease hostilities and restore full Hormuz access. (Source: @VahidOnline/77863)

Saudi Arabia condemned the tanker attacks with 'strongest terms,' held Tehran responsible for consequences, and expressed solidarity with UAE measures to protect its sovereignty and resources. (Source: @VahidOnline/77863)

Bahrain denounced the targeting as 'economic blackmail' by Iran, stressed Hormuz security for energy stability, food and medicine supply, and global trade, and urged Iran not to use the strait for pressure. (Source: @VahidOnline/77863)
Egypt called for halting all actions threatening international maritime security. (Source: @VahidOnline/77863)
Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed a large-scale ballistic missile attack on Saudi forces in the Al-Makha area, targeting missiles, weapons, and military boats. (Source: @kianmeli1/90870)
Unverified reports indicate Houthis are firing drones at Saudi Arabia. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94147)

CENTCOM reported 62 commercial vessels diverted due to the Iranian maritime blockade, while the USS George Washington carrier strike group is deploying to replace the Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79282, @mamlekate/104146)
